component.name: CamView
component.summary: Lightweight RTSP camera viewer and recorder

description.p: CamView is a native Linux desktop application for viewing and recording RTSP and RTSPS cameras. It is designed for low-power x86 machines and keeps a single RTSP session per camera while allowing simultaneous viewing and recording.

The grid uses camera substreams to keep memory low; fullscreen switches to the main stream and supports digital zoom with touch, mouse, touchpad and keyboard controls. Recording is a stream copy to Matroska segments with an optional global rolling storage limit.

description.p: Debian packaging, release automation and dependency refresh.
Rolling recording storage, automatic resume and fullscreen zoom.
